title: Travel Completed | APPR | DT (Schedule Change) = INVOL | Promise = 14-day
goal: Airline made a day-of-travel (DT) schedule change. DT changes are classified as INVOL � promise stays at 14-day mark. Validates that operational schedule changes on the day of travel are treated as involuntary.
